# Fastino Labs

> Build structured decisions with GLiDE, run schema-based extraction with GLiNER, and fine-tune specialized models with Fastino.

> ## Agent instructions
> Use https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json as the source of truth for customer-facing routes. For GLiDE decision inference, call `POST https://api.fastino.ai/v1/systemone` with model `fastino/glide`. Do not infer undocumented routes. Read API keys from `FASTINO_API_KEY` and never embed credentials in code, logs, or reports.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://docs.fastino.ai/introduction.md): Learn how Fastino provides training and inference for specialized models.
- [Fastino quickstart](https://docs.fastino.ai/quickstart.md): Create a Fastino API key and run your first inference or training request.
- [Fastino GLiDE agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-agent-skill.md): Install GLiDE instructions for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
- [Fastino GLiNER agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-agent-skill.md): Install Fastino's hosted GLiNER skill for your coding agent.

## GLiDE decision inference

- [GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide.md): Understand when to use Fastino's decision model for classification, routing, and scoring.
- [GLiDE inference](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/systemone.md): Call `POST /v1/systemone` with a shared `state` and typed `questions`; receive calibrated answers without generated text.
- [GLiDE reference](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/decision-models.md): Read the request contract, state shapes, confidence formulas, and multi-question example.
- [Noul](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-noul.md): Ask a yes/no question and receive the probability that the answer is true.
- [Choice](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-choice.md): Select one caller-defined option and receive its probability distribution.
- [Score](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-score.md): Select a level on an ordered rubric and receive a discrete score plus expected level.

## GLiNER inference

- [Inference overview](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference.md): Choose between GLiDE decision inference and GLiNER extraction.
- [Chat Completions](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/chat-completions.md): Run GLiNER entity extraction, classification, structured extraction, and relations through `POST /v1/chat/completions`.
- [GLiNER2.5](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner.md): Use multilingual, schema-driven information extraction.
- [GLiNER-2.5-Decide](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-2-5-decide.md): Use classification-tuned GLiNER for intent, routing, priority, moderation, and other operational labels.

## Models and training

- [Model catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/models.md): Browse canonical model IDs, parameters, and context windows.
- [Training API](https://docs.fastino.ai/training.md): Create and manage Fastino training jobs from submission through artifact delivery.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json): Read the authoritative contract for listed customer-facing operations.

- [Pricing](https://docs.fastino.ai/pricing.md): Review inference and training pricing.
